title: Uwell Viscore Cherry Cola Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Cherry Cola captures the iconic taste of fizzy cola with a rich cherry twist, delivering a nostalgic and flavour-packed vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, ensuring extended use and convenience. The 0.8ohm mesh coil within the pod is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, producing smooth vapour and bold flavour. The refill container allows for easy and mess-free top-ups, providing up to 8000 puffs per pod and refill combo, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod offers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it a great choice for adult vapers seeking a long-lasting and satisfying vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the fizzy, cherry-infused Cherry Cola flavour.
